question: Which is NOT a unitary feature of the Constitution of India?

options.text: Appointment of the Governor by the President

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Bicameral Legislature.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The bicameral framework,** likewise called bicameralism, is an arrangement of government in which the lawmaking body contains two houses.
 
• Bicameralism is a sort of lawmaking body, one partitioned into two separate congregations, chambers, or houses, known as a bicameral council.
 
• **Starting around 2015**, around 40% of the world's public governing bodies are bicameral, and around **60%** are unicameral.
 
• The Congress of the US is an illustration of a** bicameral framework.**
